mapper.select: select c.id, c.`name`, c.`type`, c.credit_code as creditCode, cei.clinic_number as clinicNumber, cei.address as clinicAddress, cei.tel as clinicMobile, case c.type when 0 then '公司' when 1 then '区域管理' when 2 then cei.abbreviation else '其他' end as abbreviation from company c left join clinic_ext_info cei ON c.id = cei.company_id where c.id = #{id}
